title: DAP: Debugger disconnects immediately before the project boots up (regression)
body:
### Tested versions - Reproducible in 4.5.dev [c6d130abd](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/commit/c6d130abd9188f313e6701d01a0ddd6ea32166a0), 4.5.beta3, 4.5.beta2 - Not reproducible in 4.4.1, 4.4, 4.3, didn't try earlier ### System information Godot v4.5.beta (c6d130abd) - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6614) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-13900K (32 threads) - 127.7 GiB memory ### Issue description I've been using a Neovim with [nvim-dap](https://github.com/mfussenegger/nvim-dap) to write and debug GDScript. Debugging doesn't work any longer with the 4.5 betas or the current, as of writing this, [master](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/commit/c6d130abd9188f313e6701d01a0ddd6ea32166a0). On the Godot Editor I only get the message `[DAP] Disconnected` as the very first line of the output before the project boots up. On Neovim side the debugger seems to boot up but immediately closes. I tried debugging the Godot editor to see what happens, but I didn't get very far. The below polling function encounters status `STATUS_NONE` and after that the disconnection happens. I'm unsure why that is the case, or if that's a valid case or what causes it. See https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/f11aff3841e0e721a66323bf4b3a0e71b5a14cc0/editor/debugger/debug_adapter/debug_adapter_protocol.cpp#L1185-L1212

### Steps to reproduce - Open Neovim - Start a debugging session using nvim-dap - Observe debugging starting and ending immediately I don't think that my settings affect this, but here they are anyways: ```lua return { { "mfussenegger/nvim-dap", keys = { { "", "dc", desc = "Continue", remap = true }, { "", "dt", desc = "Terminate", remap = true }, -- Shift+F5 -- stylua: ignore { "", function() require("dap").restart_frame() end, desc = "Restart frame", remap = true }, -- Ctrl+F5 { "", "db", desc = "Toggle breakpoint", remap = true }, { "", "dO", desc = "Step over", remap = true }, { "", "di", desc = "Step into", remap = true }, { "", "do", desc = "Step out", remap = true }, -- shift+F11 }, opts = function() local dap = require("dap") dap.adapters.godot = { type = "server", host = "127.0.0.1", port = 6006, } dap.configurations.gdscript = { { type = "godot", request = "launch", name = "Launch scene", project = "${workspaceFolder}", launch_scene = true, }, } end, --vim.api.nvim_create_user_command("Breakpoint", "lua require'dap'.toggle_breakpoint()", {}) --vim.api.nvim_create_user_command("Continue", "lua require'dap'.continue()", {}) --vim.api.nvim_create_user_command("StepOver", "lua require'dap'.step_over()", {}) --vim.api.nvim_create_user_command("StepInto", "lua require'dap'.step_into()", {}) --vim.api.nvim_create_user_command("REPL", "lua require'dap'.repl.open()", {}) }, } ``` ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) N/A
